scope: Authorized bounded parallel callable-agent extension; root local review and no-effects PostgreSQL/process/signed-command and mock-model qualification. Historical item7 independent review remains bound to e49a214; no P5/RG5 release or production approval.

commands.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/contracts tests/unit tests/integration tests/e2e tests/evals -m 'not live' -q -rs --junitxml=artifacts/parallel-agents/regression.xml

acceptance.overlap: Barrier-based direct members and OpenAI-compatible mock completions; two separate worker processes enter independent children before either completes
acceptance.caps: Independent team/workspace caps across two worker instances; separate processes share a workspace cap; direct SQL cannot claim above a team cap
acceptance.lineage: One canonical parent; stable unique ordered children, shared trace and intersected tool/memory/delegation scopes; recorded model invocation points to the canonical child
acceptance.authority: Signed JWT/current subject/grants, opt-in effects-disabled mode, cross-workspace denial, preflight and claim/invocation eligibility, registry/canonical/identity/scope revocation controls
acceptance.results: Typed model output is aggregated and persisted; partial success/error types and bounded output retained
acceptance.recovery: Killed worker leaves completed result unchanged, interrupted call unknown and queued sibling resumed once with original IDs; graceful shutdown drains cooperative calls; absolute deadline and cancellation preserve unknown outcomes
acceptance.idempotency: Concurrent exact submission returns one parent/children; conflicting input denied; terminal child cannot be replayed or result rewritten
acceptance.migration: Clean additive 0035 upgrade, empty rollback/re-upgrade, populated preservation refusal, canonical identities/results/events protected; prior wait/owner/schema tests retain their preservation checks
acceptance.interfaces: Actual CLI/SDK requests reach signed ASGI API; submit/inspect/cancel parity and configured fixture factory opt-in tested

development_corrections: Sequential overlap reproduced RED before parallel implementation
Trigger field lookup and syntax fixed before fresh schema tests
Reject nonfinite Python values before Pydantic JSON-mode normalization
Process-death test waits for runtime entry, not only a committed claim
Fixture manifest timeout change received a new version instead of rewriting an admitted version
Configured API verified through resolved OpenAPI paths
Three old preservation/schema-head expectations adjusted for additive 0035; unchanged canonical rows/version and owner guards still asserted
Expiry between eligibility and SQL claim update reproduced RED; a savepoint now reconciles rejected deadline/cancellation claims without stopping polling
live_models: NOT RUN; default fixtures and controlled zero-cost mock model transport only
automatic_infrastructure_scaling: Not implemented; explicitly started compatible worker processes share durable claims
